## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juǎn* commentary on [袾宏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%A2%BE%E5%AE%8F) **Yúnqī Zhūhóng**'s *Xīfāng yuànwén* [KR6p0064](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0064) — Yúnqī's standard Pure Land vow-text — composed by the early-Qīng Pure Land master [實賢](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%A6%E8%B3%A2) **Xǐng'ān Shíxián** 省庵實賢 (1685–1734), the **Eleventh Patriarch** of the orthodox Chinese Pure Land lineage. The work supplies a sustained doctrinal exposition of Yúnqī's vow-text, expanding on Yúnqī's own commentary and integrating it with the Qīng-period Pure Land doctrinal apparatus.

**Abstract**

Yúnqī's *Xīfāng yuànwén* circulates with Yúnqī's own *shì* 釋 (commentary), supplied as part of the original composition (T1160 / [KR6p0064](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0064)). Xǐng'ān's *Zhù* is therefore a **second-order commentary**: an annotation on Yúnqī's already-annotated vow-text, supplying further doctrinal cross-references, scriptural source-citations, and pastoral applications that Yúnqī's first-order commentary had not addressed. The structural division (*kē* 科) follows Yúnqī's text phrase by phrase; the annotation density is high.

The work belongs to the broader **Qīng-period Pure Land commentary tradition** in which the foundational texts of the late-Míng Pure Land synthesis — Yúnqī's writings, [傳燈](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%82%B3%E7%87%88) Chuándēng's *Lùn*, [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) Ǒuyì's *Yàojiě* — received successive layers of sub-commentary from the seventeenth- and eighteenth-century Pure Land masters. Xǐng'ān's contribution to this tradition is substantial: in addition to the present *Yuànwén zhù*, he produced a separate *Shēng wúshēng lùn zhù* on Chuándēng's *Lùn*, and his *Dōnghǎi ruò jiě* [KR6p0097](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0097) continued the tradition into Confucian-Buddhist comparative scholarship. Together these works establish Xǐng'ān as the central early-Qīng commentator on the late-Míng Pure Land canon.

The text is preserved in the *Xùzàngjīng* 卍續藏 (X1161). The dating bracket adopted (1715–1734) covers Xǐng'ān's mature period at Fèngshān / Méifēngsì up to his death.
